title: Old 78 records he might sell
summary: He has old 78 records and the interviewer offers to buy them for his record shop.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now

blocks.x: And I said, one of these times maybe I was going to try to sell them. Because I mean, I have them sitting there. I got about at least, I know, at least about eight or ten of them. Old records, man.
You mean the old 78 speed records? Yeah, old 78.
